theorem_statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero. Let H = H_{4,6}(P^1) and H^bal be as in ATT-0112 (dual-confirmed by REV-0157 and REV-0158): H is the finite-type Deligne-Mumford stack of finite degree-four covers of a fixed P^1 by smooth connected genus-six curves, smooth of pure dimension 18, and H^bal is the open locus where the packet-orientation relations bundle is F isomorphic to O(4)+O(5), likewise smooth of pure dimension 18. Let H^{sb} be the open of simply-branched points (equivalently, the open where the degree-18 branch divisor Br(gamma) is reduced). Let X be the scheme of simply-branched such covers with three distinct branch values rigidified to 0,1,infty; equivalently, X is the PGL_2-slice of H^{sb} (or any finite etale scheme cover of the coarse space of [H^{sb}/PGL_2] obtained by marking three distinct branch values). Let X^bal = X times_H H^bal, and let pi: C -> X^bal, gamma: C -> P^1_{X^bal} be the universal family. Let L = W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1} in the SRC-0004 / FND-0156 convention of ATT-0112 Section 0.1, let AJ = P_{X^bal}(pi_* L) be the Abel-Jacobi P^2-bundle of ATT-0088/CLM-0088-8, let U be its reduced-support open, and let Z = Ord(U) -> U be the finite etale right S_6-torsor of orderings. Write U^{sb}, Z^{sb} for the same objects over X^bal (already simply branched on X). THEN: (A) X is a smooth affine k-scheme of pure dimension 15, finite etale over M_{0,18}; X^bal is a dense open in X; U and Z are smooth of pure dimension 17; by ATT-0112(E) (image dimension 15 is not contained in the type-(ii) locus of dimension at most 11) one has H_beta = S_6, Z connected of degree 720 over the connected scheme U, and for every additive S_6-equivariant functor F to Q-vector spaces or mixed Q-Hodge structures, F(Z)^{S_6} isomorphic to F(U). In particular the H_alpha-object of ordinary, compactly supported, or Borel-Moore cohomology of a connected component of the ordering cover is identified, with Q-coefficients, with the corresponding cohomology of U. (B) Each geometric fibre of U -> X^bal is the complement of a positive-degree curve in P^2, hence a smooth affine surface; thus U -> X^bal is affine of pure relative dimension 2, R^q f_! Q = 0 for q < 2, and each R^q f_! Q is mixed of weights at most q. (C) For the affine ambient X of dimension 15 and Y = X \ X^bal, the compact-support localization sequence and Deligne's weight bound weights(H_c^m(Y)) <= m imply that for every j < 15 the group H_c^j(X^bal; Q) has weights at most j-1, hence Gr^W_j H_c^j(X^bal; Q) = 0. (D) The compact-support Leray spectral sequence for f: U -> X^bal therefore has E_2^{p,q} = H_c^p(X^bal; R^q f_! Q) contributing to H_c^{16}(U) only for q >= 2 (so p = 16-q <= 14 < 15). The associated graded Gr^W_{16} of each such term vanishes by (C) and the weight ceiling weights(H_c^p(base; V)) <= p + (weight ceiling of V). Consequently Gr^W_{16} H_c^{16}(U; Q) = 0. Finite etale descent gives the same vanishing for Z. Poincare duality on the smooth 17-fold U (resp. Z) yields Gr^W_{18} H^{18}(U; Q) = 0, and Borel-Moore duality yields W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(U; Q) = 0 and W_{-16} H^{BM}_{16}(Z; Q) = 0. These vanishing groups are of Tate type Q(-8) (compact), Q(8) (Borel-Moore), and Q(-9) (ordinary H^{18}), matching the exact codimension-13 / target-degree numerics of RED-0001 after the not-asserted codimension-4 Gysin twist Q(-4). NOT ASSERTED: Tate type of the complementary closed incidence over the non-simply-branched locus in H^bal (dimension at most 16 after the PGL_2-slice); any Gysin map, closed embedding, purity, or contribution statement inside M_{6,6}; mixed-Tate cohomology of X, of H^bal, or of a finite pushforward of Q along the branch morphism (FND-0085 and FND-0054 stand); integral coefficients or coarse-space descent (FND-0075 stands); stack-inertia component formulae (FND-0144 stands).
